<SUGGESTION>The docstring should clearly describe the function's purpose and the conditions under which anchor elements are modified. It should also provide more detail on the behavior of the function.

Here's a revised docstring:

```docstring
Modifies anchor elements to open in a new tab if they are external links.

This function iterates over all anchor elements in the document and checks if they are external links. If an anchor element is an external link, it sets the 'target' attribute to '_blank' and 'rel' attribute to 'noopener'. Additionally, it sets a custom data attribute to indicate whether the link is internal or external.

@returns {void} No value is returned. The function modifies the DOM elements in place.
```
